name: console-02-overview
prompt: Turn this into a different screen of the same console, edge to edge with no browser window. Keep exactly: the left sidebar (the S logo, "Smart-Clearance", "Console", the navigation list and Neha Kulkarni at the bottom) and the visual system. In the sidebar, "Overview" is now the selected item. Replace the whole main area, top to bottom: no client header, no tabs, no agent list and no side panel remain. Main area: 1) A large title "Overview" and the grey line "Saturday 4 October · 1 client live · 10 agents on". 2) A section "Batches on the move" with two wide white tracker rows with thin hairline edges: the first row shows an orange rounded tile with a white m, "MF-2409-117 · Masala Chips 150 g · Rakesh Traders, Nagpur", a horizontal nine-stop tracker with eight green stops filled and the ninth empty, and on the right "₹21,152 recovered" in green; the second row shows the same orange tile, "MF-2410-118 · Mango Drink 200 ml · Lakshmi Agencies, Hyderabad", a nine-stop tracker with seven green stops filled, and on the right "1,372 to kiranas · 150 staff sale · 58 food bank". 3) Below, two white cards side by side. Left card "Needs attention" with two rows, each with a small amber dot: "Patil Distributors · one-time permission not given yet" and "Gupta & Sons · stock export arrived 2 h late"; right card "Agent runs today" with five rows in small monospace times: "09:00 Watcher · 2 batches at risk", "09:14 Vision · label read, 0.97", "09:21 Valuer · 5 exits priced", "09:22 Router · plan sent to Priya", "10:05 Negotiator · countered ₹14.20". Crisp flat interface; all text legible.
postprocess: WebP; the PNG original stays local in .impeccable/mocks/
use: SC-25 design board: Console overview: two batch tracker rows (MF-2409-117 with ₹21,152 recovered, MF-2410-118 split across kiranas, staff sale and food bank), a 'Needs attention' card with two amber items and an 'Agent runs today' list.
